text:
incident-bot: [P1] Inference latency spike detected for production-rt (region: us-west-2). 90th p95 token latency > 2.5s for last 3m. Auto-pager sent to #incidents and on-call. Alert id: alert_2026_4140001234

emma (oncall): ACK. I'm on it, joining war room. Setting owner to myself for now.

miguel (sre): grabbing logs+metrics. Can you open an ops bridge? I'll run a quick `kubectl` check and tail the runtime logs.

emma (oncall): Created war room: https://meet.redwood.example/ops/4140001234 (ops-bridge). Added incident channel thread to meeting invite.

ops-rotation: I paged the secondary oncall (pranav) and added him to the bridge. Secondary will be standby for infra actions.

pranav (infra): I'm on the bridge. Initial check: cluster GPU pool shows 78% util, no OOM. Redis KV cache error rate increased ~4x at 02:44:10 UTC. Pulling pod-level traces.

miguel (sre): Correlating: runtime shredder logs show repeated KV cache timeouts and increased batching backpressure starting at 02:43:50. Suspect prefix cache eviction cascade.

emma (oncall): Customer impact: some hosted API requests seeing high tail latency, but no 5xx spikes yet. I'm drafting a status page update. Please confirm wording.

sara (pm): Please include likely affected models (gpt-lite-v1 variants) and note that we've routed heavy routes to cheaper fallback model temporarily. Customers with reserved capacity shouldn't be affected.

emma (oncall): StatusPage draft below — please quick review: 
```
Summary: We are investigating increased inference latency affecting the hosted API in us-west-2.
Impact: A subset of requests to gpt-lite-v1 may experience elevated response times. No increased error rates observed at this time.
Action: On-call team is actively investigating; we have opened an ops bridge and applied temporary routing to fallback model variants for heavy routes.
ETA: Next update in 20 minutes or when we have a mitigation.
```

pranav (infra): Approved. Add note about cache throttling: "root cause under investigation: KV cache throttling observed".

miguel (sre): Runbook step executed: `runbook/inference/cache-eviction.md` step 2. Flushing prefix cache on cluster node gp01 completed. Observed partial latency improvement for subset of requests.

emma (oncall): Noted. Updating status page now. statuspage-bot: please publish the above draft as a "Investigating" incident.

statuspage-bot: Published incident on status.redwood.example (incident: INC-2026-4140001234). Visibility: public.

emma (oncall): Short-term mitigation: continue prefix cache flush and throttle heavy routes. Long-term: quantify cache TTL/size mismatch. Assign follow-up owner for postmortem after incident.

sara (pm): I'll own customer comms for top 5 customers. Miguel/pranav — please save logs and timestamps.

miguel (sre): Saving traces and upload to artifact store: s3://redwood-incidents/4140001234/traces.tar.gz.

emma (oncall): Confirming handoff plan: I'll stay on bridge for 30m. If latencies are stable, we'll downgrade to "monitoring". If regression occurs, escalate to SEA infra lead.

ops-rotation: Added followup checklist to thread: runbook link, artifacts, statuspage id, customers notified. :white_check_mark: 

pranav (infra): Noted. Continuing to monitor. Will post a final update in 15m unless there is a change.

emma (oncall): Final quick note: if anyone adds tooling changes to routing, please ping here before merging.

statuspage-bot: Next update scheduled at +20m.
